# HEM v0.8.2b2

Each room now has one face drawn in the card’s colors. Its expression shows thermal comfort, a droplet or a cracked mark shows humid or dry air, and a mask shows poor air quality. These features appear together when several readings are out of range. The existing home-wide switch and translated descriptions apply.

The dashboard now retries an interrupted card download in the same screen and can try again when the app returns to the foreground or connectivity returns. The HACS package includes a compressed copy for faster first loads. This addresses a reproducible loading failure that can leave Home Assistant showing “Custom element doesn’t exist” until refresh.
